response.original_title: Ain't Too Proud: The Life and Times of The Temptations
response.overview: The Broadway musical charting the rise of The Temptations from the streets of Detroit to the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame, told through their classic hits, with a book by Dominique Morisseau and direction by Des McAnuff. Recorded on the North American tour in Memphis, Tennessee, in March 2023.
